evidence.basis: The unchanged Young 2021 Toth, GAB, LDF-rate and process-heat values are evaluated with IAPWS local saturation in a named exploratory scenario. Actual temperatures are recorded; the requested 116 C value and former 20-120 C range are not hard validity boundaries. Genuine equation-domain branches remain enforced. This package adds an opt-in dry numerical continuation policy; the accepted advisory package remains unchanged. This separately identified package adds bounded internal BDF trial recovery; original strict and five-atol packages remain unchanged.
evidence.not_for: validated equilibrium or coupling outside 25-70 C, measured humid-cycle accuracy, validated hot-vacuum rates or energy transfer, equipment suitability, cyclic steady state, lifetime, degradation trigger, or annual production.
